### 🕹️ Skyblock Realm Player Move

> **Just click "Submit new issue" below to execute your turn!**

The automated Skyblock game engine will:
1. 🎮 Process your move or crafting action.
2. 🎨 Re-render the 3D isometric island SVG.
3. 📦 Update inventory and close this issue automatically in ~15 seconds.
